name: org.breakwire/breakwire
title: Breakwire
description: Look up an API/SDK error; get the source-linked breaking change, deprecation or advisory and fix.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Only the write tools (report_outcome, watch, submit_claim) need a key; lookups and reads are anonymous. Get a key via POST https://breakwire.org/api/agents (see /llms.txt).
